<reason>CON won the live comparison: credits are the wrong instrument—late, regressive, and a cheap substitute for help now—while PRO’s invoice-test and contribution-gap case stayed powerful but never killed timing, targeting, or crowd-out. PRO held the motion’s “credits vs invisibility” binary tightly; CON still made it easier to vote no on this policy.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>CON’s R2 A1/A2: a tax transfer is honest, adjustable, and paid when needed, while a pension credit disguises the same spend as earned insurance and still leaves today’s caregiver with nothing until seventy.</best_rebuttal>
